labels.note: Encryption at rest for all user data contradicts plaintext storage of user preferences.
Same subject (API timeouts) with incompatible numeric constraints (2s vs 10s).
Irreversible bcrypt hashing contradicts administrators viewing stored passwords in plaintext; dissimilar-sounding pair per ADR-01 DR-10.
Admin sessions expire after 5 minutes of inactivity, but all sessions must stay active until explicit logout; dissimilar wording.
Guest sessions expire after 5 minutes of inactivity, but all sessions must stay active until explicit logout; dissimilar wording.
Both require a second authentication factor at sign-in; each covers the other, wording differs only.
Both require logging failed login attempts; each covers the other, wording differs only.
Both require recording successful login attempts; each covers the other, wording differs only.
Emailing a confirmation requires a verified email address to exist.
Retaining data for the configured period requires retention periods to be configurable per data category.
Password reset email depends on a stored verified email address for the user.
'Promptly' has no numeric bound; readers may assume wildly different timings.
'User-friendly' has no measurable criterion.
'Modern look and feel' is subjective and non-measurable.
'Multiple document formats' does not enumerate which formats are required.
99.9% uptime lacks a measurement window (monthly, quarterly, annual).
'Account is modified' does not enumerate modification types or notification channel.
'Alert' does not say who is alerted or through which channel.
Same expiry rule, different subjects (admin vs guest) - different scope, not a conflict.
Google OAuth narrows OAuth2 support; neither covers the other and neither needs the other (coverage test).
Logging failed logins and alerting after repeated failures are complementary behaviors.
Same 2-second timeout rule applied to different subjects (API requests vs database queries).
Supported document formats and the file size limit are independent upload rules.
Logging successful logins and recording failed logins are complementary, not duplicates.
